payload.summary: Historical Digital Retina already implemented a rich structured percept schema and positive/negative E2E gating, while its reports expose hallucination cascades and threshold-sensitive coverage claims. Use it as schema/test ancestry, not as proof of current VLM equivalence.
mandatory_harness_implications: typed VisualPercept fields with provenance/confidence and parent ancestry
positive AND negative gating equivalence across H1/H2/H3
weak parent detection invalidates or discounts derived captions
acceptance measures FRANK-delivered/used percept semantics, not latent CLIP recognizability
threshold curves and immutable machine result IDs replace cherry-picked metric points
secret scan/redaction before historical executable source enters training corpora
payload.credit_boundary: No credit for the already-recorded decision that Digital Retina is mandatory inside FRANK; only implementation/schema/test/oracle reuse is eligible.
